decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a flexible time-of-day preference ranging from afternoon through evening, not as a fixed cutoff.
decisions.canonical_value: For return flights, softly prefer afternoon or evening departures, including after 6:00 p.m. when suitable.
decisions.condition: When selecting a return flight and multiple departure times are available
decisions.default_action: Prioritize return options departing in the afternoon or evening
decisions.exception_condition: Use another departure period when explicitly requested for the current trip or when no workable later-day option is available.
decisions.name: Prefer later-day return flights
decisions.rationale: The examples consistently support a later-day preference specifically for return legs, while allowing variation from afternoon to evening. This is a reusable travel habit rather than a one-off constraint, and it is not an alias of the broader afternoon-departure policy because its return-leg scope and later acceptable range are distinct.

decisions.boundary_condition: Do not apply the preference to a leg for which another time of day is explicitly requested.
decisions.canonical_value: Softly prefer afternoon flight departures when the applicable leg has workable afternoon options.
decisions.condition: When selecting a flight departure time and afternoon options are available
decisions.default_action: Prioritize departure options in the afternoon.
decisions.exception_condition: Use another departure period when explicitly requested or when no workable afternoon option is available.
decisions.name: Prefer afternoon departures
decisions.rationale: Multiple examples support a recurring soft preference for afternoon departures. It remains separate from the return-flight policy because the evidence does not limit it to return legs and does not establish an evening preference.
